notes.title: "OMUSUBI" Major Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049488/4d56069b21255235f0e021b75cba986a7eddba5e.jpg

"OMUSUBI" Major Update Now Live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2634560

On Saturday, April 19, the major update for the Japanese-style horror adventure game "OMUSUBI" has been released.

This update introduces a brand-new area, expanding the map and unlocking additional story content for players to enjoy.

With numerous new stills added, the visual immersion in each scene has also been greatly enhanced.

If you haven’t yet, now’s the perfect time to step into the twilight realm between this world and the next—the Hell's Edge.

▼Play now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2634560
